title: For My Favorite Person
subtitle: tap a gift to open it
messages: You're my favorite notification.
I still get butterflies, even on the thousandth 'I love you.'
Being with you is my favorite feeling.
You make my heart smile.
You're my happy place.
Home is wherever I'm with you.
I didn't know what my heart was capable of until it met yours.
I love you not because of who you are, but because of who I am when I am with you.
You are my calm in the chaos.
Out of all the people in the world, I just can't believe you're mine.
In a room full of art, I'd still stare at you.
You always look beautiful to me, especially when you forget that you are.
How can I help? Tell me what you need, I'm right here.
Whatever happens today, I'm just glad we get to face it together.
You never have to carry anything alone as long as I'm around.
Your laugh is my favorite sound in the whole world.
Even our quiet moments together feel like my favorite memories.
I'd choose you today, tomorrow, and every day after that.
You make me want to be the best version of myself.
Thank you for being you. I'm so lucky it's me who gets to love you.
